odc_type: Incorrect type checking for inner class instantiation
observation_summary: An InstantationException is thrown when attempting to create a mock instance of an inner class.
reasoning_summary: The failing test indicates that the ConstructorInstantiator is unable to create an instance of an inner class. The stack trace points to a failure in the logic that handles outer class instances. In Java, non-static inner classes require an instance of the enclosing class to be passed to their constructor. The ConstructorInstantiator likely fails to correctly identify or pass the outer instance when the target class is an inner class, leading to an instantiation exception.
